snippet.title: [♬] MENU. - PAPER.VOID OST
snippet.description:
ℹ️ "MENU." is a soundtrack used in the upcoming Indie Game "PAPER.VOID" specifically when the player is in the Menu of the game. All visuals and audio composed and produced by Homeannor.

🎮 PAPER.VOID is an abstract flying game. Collect VOID CUBES. Don't die. And no, the VOID won't make this easy for you. Free drawing in the VOID is also an option too. Apart from the secret unlocks, the game really doesn't get much more complicated than that... Or does it.

✈️ PLAY PAPER.VOID (DEMO COMING SOON!):
https://homeannor.itch.io/papervoid

🎵 Like what you see? Here's some more PAPER.VOID OSTs! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYglE2gLMlVDZy9e0Cn9A4nEflyeRLF2o

🤍 If you have any questions or feedback, please drop it in the comments or join the Dev Mafia Discord Server!

== ⏲️ Timestamps ==
0:00 - MENU.
1:25 - DROP 1.
2:08 - ROTATE.
2:29 - DROP 2.
3:33 - ROTATING.

🏠 Just a Game Developer making soundtracks... Intense? Calm? Upbeat? I've probably done it before.

Feel free to check out my stuff below if you like what I do.
